mounika.text:
[PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY]
Lead Automation Engineer with 4+ years of experience supporting automation system validation, scenario testing, and process verification across manufacturing, life sciences, and EPC industrial environments. Proficient in Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, Siemens TIA Portal, and Ignition Perspective automation platforms, with hands-on execution of scenario-based testing, control logic validation, and multi-discipline project coordination. Delivers end-to-end automation project support from requirements definition through commissioning sign-off across concurrent production deployments. Seeking to apply industrial automation expertise and process optimization experience to drive simulation-driven manufacturing improvements at Celestica.

[TECHNICAL SKILLS]
Core Automation & Process Validation: Functional testing, scenario testing, integration testing, system validation, UAT, FAT (Factory Acceptance Test), SAT (Site Acceptance Test), smoke testing, regression testing, black-box testing, exploratory testing.
Automation Tools & Scripting: Python test scripting, Pytest, Robot Framework, Postman, REST API testing, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, SoapUI.
Industrial Automation Platforms: Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, Siemens TIA Portal, Siemens S7-1200/1500, Ignition Perspective, FactoryTalk View SE, Siemens WinCC, AVEVA InTouch, DOPSoft.
Manufacturing & Process Validation: MES (Manufacturing Execution System) validation, HMI/SCADA testing, robotic system validation, vision inspection system testing, assembly process verification, commissioning documentation.
Project & Test Management: JIRA, TestRail, ServiceNow, test plan development, traceability matrices, defect density tracking, test coverage metrics, project lifecycle coordination.
Data & Operational Reporting: SQL-based data validation, OSIsoft PI Historian, OPC UA data validation, historian data verification, OPC UA data validation, operational data verification, test execution reporting.
Embedded & Automotive Testing: C/C++ unit testing, CAN bus communication validation, sensor signal validation, firmware regression testing, ECU boundary condition analysis, hardware-in-the-loop validation.
Standards & Compliance: IEC 61131-3, Agile/Scrum, V-model, TDD, NFPA 70, OSHA compliance, safety interlock validation, quality assurance standards.
